files.content:
# Pixel Color Palette Generator

A small offline browser app that shows five color swatches with hex codes, generates fresh harmonious palettes, and lets you lock individual colors while generating new ones.

## Features

- Five color swatches with visible hex labels
- One-click harmonious palette generation
- Lock/unlock toggle on each swatch
- Keyboard-accessible, labeled controls
- Responsive layout from 360px wide and up
- No dependencies, packages, or network requests

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. No build step or local server is required.

## How It Works

The app stores a five-color palette in memory. The Generate button creates a new palette using HSL color harmony offsets. Locked colors are left unchanged, and if any colors are locked, generation anchors around the first locked color for a more cohesive result.

output.explanation: A complete offline pixel color palette generator built with semantic HTML, responsive CSS, and plain JavaScript. It maintains five swatches, generates harmonious HSL-derived palettes, preserves locked colors, and provides accessible keyboard-focused controls.

Add centered card layout and themed background
Define 5 color swatch placeholders and a Generate button
Use addEventListener for button and controls

phases.name: Palette generation logic
tasks: Implement harmonious color generation algorithm in plain JavaScript
Return 5 hex color values and update swatch backgrounds
Display hex code labels on each swatch
Generate an initial palette on page load

phases.name: Lock toggle and interactions
tasks: Add lock toggle control to each swatch
Keep locked colors unchanged when Generate is clicked
Implement Generate button click handler to replace only unlocked colors

phases.name: Responsive styling and polish
tasks: Style swatches, Generate button, and lock toggles with a cohesive 3-5 color palette
Add visible hover, focus, and pressed states
Make layout work from 360px wide
Use system fonts at 16px or larger with clear visual hierarchy and spacing

phases.name: README and final QA
tasks: Write README with run instructions and feature summary
Test app offline in a browser at 360px and desktop widths
Verify no imports, packages, network requests, external assets, or inline HTML event handlers
Perform final visual and interaction acceptance pass

risks: Harmonious palette generation may produce low-contrast or visually similar colors
Locked and unlocked swatch states may be unclear without strong visual feedback
Responsive layout may overflow at 360px if swatches do not wrap correctly
Accessibility requirements such as keyboard focus and labeled controls could be missed
